recovery.method: Decode the first complete JSON value from the original durable bash log; keep the 650-byte task-lifecycle trailer outside the census. Preserve parsed values in this normalized derivative. No census replay.

definitions.serialPssBytes: Sum of non-atomic serial smaps_rollup observations; kernel kB multiplied by1024. Not cgroup memory, retained ownership or matched reduction.
definitions.role: Exact executable basename plus service argument; named entry basename is classification, not initiating caller.

limitations: Single passive observation; ambient workload uncontrolled.
No GC, inspector, snapshot, signal, restart, trim or cache mutation.
Later low PSS/absence cannot establish recovery of historical 4.2GiB compiler services.

qualification.writer: Original command preserved in harness_shared.tool_invocations id31408670 args_json.command; smaps_rollup Pss/Rss/Anonymous kernel kB multiplied by1024, serial reads over cgroup.procs membership captured at command start.
qualification.coverage: 22/22 captured release-service members and 1/1 staging-service member were sampled, with no missed reads and unchanged systemd MainPID. Only five largest rows per service and esbuild rows were persisted; complete per-process rows were not persisted.
qualification.classification: The original parser selects a JavaScript-looking argv argument and its basename. It does not use the maintained exact Node-entry parser. named-node-entry identifies a candidate, not a verified HTTP worker, cluster role, useful-context owner or initiating query. Native esbuild uses basename plus a --service= prefix; no native row was observed.
qualification.ancestry: The five recorded release top rows each report parentPid178515. This is a same-sample parent relationship, not a complete process-lifetime record. No native ancestry was exercised because nativeEsbuild is empty.
qualification.currentness: This is the original 21:55Z snapshot, not current runtime or source-suite acceptance. No loaded build or bundle fingerprint was captured.
qualification.result: High-PSS candidate Node host processes are the next measured attribution targets. No compiler service was observed in the captured membership. Absence cannot establish historical instance recovery or a non-defect disposition.
qualification.acceptance: Passive inventory only; no matched ordinary-workload PSS/allocation comparison, retained-owner/native disposition, R8/R9 acceptance, independent verification or shipment.
